title: Notice Regarding Approval of an Extension of the Filing Deadline of Annual Securities Report for the 53rd Fiscal Year
excerpt: The annual securities report filing deadline was extended from June 30 to September 30, 2026.
summary: Nidec received regulatory approval to extend the filing deadline for its annual securities report covering the year ended March 31, 2026 from June 30 to September 30, 2026. The company said it planned to finalize the filing following the accounting auditor's audit by the extended deadline, leaving current audited annual financial evidence unavailable as of this review.
